reviewed_not_selected.reason: Related reusable synthesis-instruction evolution; editorial nonselection.

reviewed_not_selected.reason: Continual skill internalization rather than a demonstrated recursively changing improvement process.

reviewed_not_selected.reason: Related symbolic local-repair study; editorial nonselection.

reviewed_not_selected.reason: Related inherited environment evolution; editorial nonselection.

reviewed_not_selected.title: Learning to Design SR Solvers: Harness Optimization for Symbolic Regression
reviewed_not_selected.reason: Related domain-specific harness search; editorial nonselection.

reviewed_not_selected.reason: Primarily continual policy learning with selectively triggered expert supervision.

reviewed_not_selected.reason: Primarily within-run graph-access tool revision; cross-task durable inheritance not established by reviewed abstract.
